name: Rifu (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Rifu town emblem in green: a stylised two-leaved sprout.
history: Municipal flag of Rifu, a town in Miyagi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 10 March 1975.

features.role: Rifu town emblem — a stylised two-leaved sprout
